# psi

## Overview
Generated GrammarKit PSI interfaces and Visitor for Dart language syntax tree nodes.

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.DartVisitor
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.DartElement
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.DartClassDefinition
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.Dart* (179 PSI interfaces)
- ./impl/ABOUT.md

## Invariants
- Defines public contracts for Dart AST nodes and AST visitor dispatch.

## Side Effects
- Read-only PSI tree traversal.
